metadata.title: Soft-Focus 80s Studio Portrait with Geometric Graphic Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A warm, grainy studio portrait featuring a central subject in dark attire, contrasted by a top-right corner graphic lockup using overlapping geometric shapes and multi-colored sans-serif type.
triggerTerms: grainy film aesthetic with geometric overlays
warm sepia-toned portrait with graphic corner logo
excludeWhen: sharp high-definition modern photography is required
outdoor natural lighting is the primary focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of a bearded man with dark curly hair, wearing a black turtleneck and blazer, posed with arms crossed against a textured, warm-toned studio backdrop. The image is characterized by heavy film grain and soft-focus diffusion. A distinct graphic element in the upper right corner consists of jagged, paper-cut-like shapes in pastel blue and pink, overlaid with a black rectangle containing stylized, multi-colored sans-serif lettering.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with head in the upper third
Warm, desaturated background contrasting with the deep black of the subject's clothing
Graphic lockup in top-right corner providing a modern, geometric counterpoint to the soft photography
Heavy film grain unifying the photographic and graphic elements
coreInvariants: Warm, earthy color palette (ochre, brown, black)
Arms-crossed pose with direct eye contact

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central medium shot, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark beard, framed by the dark turtleneck.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the subject's eyes, moves down to the crossed arms, then travels to the graphic element in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Textured studio walls provide significant negative space on the left and right sides of the subject.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white and pale pink in the graphic elements.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted teal and yellow within the letterforms.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the black clothing and the tan background.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to muted, 80s-era earth tones and pastels

letterConstructionRules: Letters are tightly packed and sometimes overlapping
Individual letters assigned different colors (teal, yellow, white)
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are cropped or partially obscured by overlapping rectangles
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold sans-serif paired with small technical metadata fonts in the bottom corner.
graphicDevices: Solid black rectangular container for text
Compact Disc logo in bottom right

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and geometric feel of the era
Provides the necessary geometric structure for the blocky layout

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of a man with a beard and curly hair, wearing a black turtleneck and blazer, arms crossed, against a grainy ochre-colored wall. Apply a heavy film grain and a 1980s diffusion filter.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a graphic lockup in the top right corner featuring a black rectangle over jagged pastel blue and pink shapes. Inside the rectangle, place bold geometric sans-serif text with letters in alternating teal, yellow, and white colors.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible across the entire image?
Does the lighting feel soft and diffused rather than harsh?
Is the graphic element in the top right corner composed of overlapping geometric layers?
Are the colors in the text muted rather than neon?

adjustableVariables: Colors of the geometric background shapes
Subject's specific facial hair and hair style
mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and corner graphic

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the grain does not look like digital noise.
Check that the text is legible despite the tight tracking.
Verify the 'paper-cut' edges of the background shapes look slightly irregular.
Confirm the subject's pose feels relaxed and characteristic of 80s ballad covers.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus portrait + heavy film grain + warm earth tones + geometric corner graphic overlay.
